required_findings.title: Mixed-valid patch must retain current-quote invalid value/domain blockers
required_findings.amendment: Distinguish provably non-current rejected proposal from fully validated pending correction and current/unknown invalid field. Current/unknown invalid fields remain blockers until that field validates and readback confirms; valid unrelated fields cannot unlock. Add mixed valid WEIGHT/current-quote wrong-value BUST and invalid-domain controls.

required_findings.title: Define recovery scope and partial replacement behavior across writer entry paths
required_findings.amendment: Keep pending profile corrections global to request/source/profile; use code-owned origin scope across inline, standalone, and identical-patch batch. Define partial replacement before CAS, preferably reject missing grounded pending fields. A different fit target cannot clear profile pending. Preserve commit uncertainty separately. Add focused entry-path/target controls.

required_findings.title: Freeze behavioral gate and control predicates before observing j1 outputs
required_findings.amendment: Require at least one valid behavioral non-direct-quote response in A, so technical errors alone cannot open conditional gate; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE/NOT_RUN without retries. Freeze identical ACK/cart one-step allowed and forbidden predicates for A/B. Keep all errors in denominator and separate NOT_RUN from attempted samples; reserve terminal usability claims for paired native.

optional_findings.title: Freeze native-wire metadata field list, insertion point and byte-bound checks
optional_findings.amendment: Use actual emitted schemas after native projection; ensure metadata survives presentation and only allowlisted final-wire field differs; rerun byte bounds after insertion, without production hook or context removal.

optional_findings.title: Freeze matched-pair dispatch order and source-lifetime headroom
optional_findings.amendment: Keep pairs adjacent and freeze actual-time deadline/headroom; fail closed to NOT_RUN if source lifetime cannot cover dispatch. Do not renew timestamps or switch bundles between arms.
